choose.title: Choose a conversation
choose.body: Or start a new one from the list.

list.title: Conversations
list.emptyWrite: Ask a question, then edit any reply that is wrong. Edited and approved replies become training data.
list.emptyRead: A reviewer, a trainer or an administrator can start conversations.

remove.title: Remove {title}?
remove.body: The conversation and its messages are removed.

composer.label: Message
composer.hint: Enter sends. Shift and Enter add a line.
composer.readOnly: Reading only. A reviewer, a trainer or an administrator can write here.

status.failedUnknown: The reply could not be completed.

edit.thinkingHint: Leave empty to remove the thinking.

training.included: The reply is used for training.
training.excluded: The reply is no longer used for training.

restore.replyBody: The edit is removed and the reply goes back to what the model wrote.
restore.thinkingBody: The edit is removed and the thinking goes back to what the model wrote.

expert.tokens: {prompt} in the prompt, {reply} in the reply

settings.title: Conversation settings
settings.intro: A setting left unchanged follows the project.
settings.instructionsHint: Leave empty to use the project's instructions.
settings.temperatureHint: Low values give steady replies. High values give more varied ones.
settings.topPHint: Low values keep to the most likely words. High values allow less common ones.
settings.maxTokensHint: Counted in tokens. A reply stops when it reaches this length.

errors.no_engine: No engine is set up to run models.
errors.model_not_on_disk: The base model isn't downloaded yet.
errors.engine_timeout: The engine took too long to answer.
errors.engine_rejected_token: Mesbah's access token is not valid on this engine.
errors.needs_gguf: This version needs a GGUF export first.
errors.engine_base_mismatch: This engine runs a different base model than the project.
errors.training_in_progress: Training is using the memory. Chat again when it ends.
errors.no_version: This project has no version to chat with.
errors.message_changed: Someone else changed this reply. Try again to replace their change.
errors.not_editable: Only a finished reply from the model can be edited.

approved.explain: A reply marked as right. Approved replies and edited replies become the examples the model trains on next time.
